string.name: com_facebook_share_button_text
string.description: This is a button. It is located on the home page for all games. Tapping this allows the user to share this game as a post on their timeline.

resources.string: Visit facebook.com/device and enter the code shown above.
To connect your account, open the Facebook app on your mobile device and check for notifications.

string.name: com_facebook_android_lva_pending_title
string.description: Title of the screen shown while the login finishes in another app (Instagram or the browser); first shown alone with a progress indicator, then with Continue and Cancel

string.name: com_facebook_android_lva_pending_body
string.description: Body of the same screen, shown with Continue and Cancel only when the login hasn't finished after a short wait or the user returns to the app. It must not imply that Cancel undoes a login already done in the browser

resources.string: This may take a moment. If nothing happens, tap Continue.

string.name: com_facebook_android_lva_pending_continue
string.description: Primary button on the same screen; reopens the login
